dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: Let me see, dear guest. Ah, you have flown with Nachtraben Airlines several times now...

dialogues.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
dialogues.text: We're currently doing a survey, in truth. Could I ask how you feel about the quality of service that we have provided so far?

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: To receive your acknowledge is a great honor indeed.

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: Alright, next question. How do you feel about the services of our flight attendants?

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: Wonderful. We are honored to have served you well.

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: Thank you for your answers. Your feedback is very important to us. Please, do enjoy your stay!

choices.text: I don't quite feel at home.

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: I see. So we have not yet done all that we could...

choices.text: I gotta say I don't fly with you very often.

response.speaker: Night Raven Flight Attendant
response.text: Hmm. Is this perhaps because our routes are insufficiently well planned?
